title: feat: short list views, roadmaps as data, install checks merges
headline: The list reads as one short line per row, and every kit project keeps its roadmap as data: a hand-kept checkbox roadmap moves in once. Install checks a hand merge before it records one, and the guards stop holding the kit's own scripts.
alignment: v1.36.0 is the v2.0 install step (T5) with the list views: no hand merge left unchecked, and every project's roadmap kept as data.

items.text: state.mjs list prints one short line per row (id, tag, step, severity, origin, a stored short name); `list --agent` prints one JSON line per row; `item <id>` prints the whole row; `list --full` keeps the full titles.
items.after: One line a row, a stored short name

items.text: Every row carries a short name of at most 60 characters: a new row must give one, and list shorten fills one in once for rows from before 1.36.0.

list import also reads a checkbox roadmap: each box becomes a row and each version heading a roadmap step; the boxes leave the file, kept as it was in .kit/kit-backups, and a generated view shows them again.
items.before: Kept by hand, unreadable by import
items.after: Moved into data once, view generated

items.text: The roadmap template carries the generated roadmap and boxes views; the use check fails until a hand-kept checkbox roadmap is moved into the data. A new tag, blocked, stands for a [!] box.
step rename renames a roadmap step by its name or release, and `list --step` shows one step's rows.
A read-only `Explore` helper on `Sonnet` installs into each kit project, in place of the built-in one that runs on the session's model; a project without the kit keeps the built-in.
CI shape templates for Node and Python projects, and ci-shape.mjs, which reports what a project's workflows lack (main-only triggers, stale-run cancel, one required check) and never fails a run.

Status and session start flag a `claude` CLI older than 2.1.325, which fixed gaps in Bash deny and ask rules, naming npm when a package manager lags, and warn when updates come from the stable channel.

The use check fails while git tracks `.claude/settings.local.json`, whose saved approvals can hold secrets, and while a project settings file sets disableAllHooks; the CI templates fail on the latter too.
Session start names a user layer newer than the project and what that can break.
Each shell command starts again in the project folder (CLAUDE_BASH_MAINTAIN_PROJECT_WORKING_DIR in the template settings).
A change to the list or the roadmap writes its views at once; an empty view block is always filled.
An installed state.mjs run from outside any project reads its own project, and names the folder it read.
The guards let 2>&1, and a plain Set-Location before a command, run a kit script instead of holding it as a write to a protected file.
A Write, Edit or NotebookEdit aimed into a kit project from outside it runs that project's guards; one through a hard link or a network path is held.
`install --merged` is refused on a file left unchanged since install named the merge; the same command again keeps the file as it is.
items.after: Refused on a file left as it was

items.text: Memory metadata the memory service adds is no change to fold back or a reason to skip an update; a file updated over it is kept first.
list import moves only boxes markdown shows as boxes, carries a box's own lines into its note, keeps each line's ending, refuses a linked folder, and names the steps it made and the names it clipped.
A node option that names a protected file (a warnings file, a profile folder) is held as a write.
The CI templates' hooks step reads the settings as JSON and fails when only one settings file exists; before, it passed with hooks off.
The testing rule no longer says a project's CI runs the guard proofs; only the kit's CI can.

verification: Every new test failed on the code before it, the sweep's fixes included. A test that runs the CI templates' hooks step for real found it never failed; it now reads JSON.
A dry run of the 1.35.0 install on both real projects and the workbench found no hand merge left; one project merged 4 files on its own.
Recall: median 13 of 14 over five candidate runs, baseline 12, control 0. The one question that misses more (push and PR) is on a rule this build did not change.

decisions.decision: Both views, a stored short name
decisions.why: The owner picked this by pop-up after seeing both: a person reads the short table, a script reads one JSON line a row, and the whole row is `item <id>`.
The owner's pop-up pick (K69). The use check fails until a hand-kept roadmap is moved, and the import keeps the file as it was in `.kit/kit-backups`.
The owner picked a check over writing a .gitignore line, which would break the rule that the kit leaves nothing git can see.

decisions.decision: Roles stay user level, Explore per project
decisions.why: A project role file's hooks do not run until the folder is trusted, and never in print mode, so the five roles stay in the user folder; only a hook-free Explore installs per project.

dimensions.name: Privacy
dimensions.result: Import and backup stay inside the project; a linked folder is refused

dimensions.name: Code security
dimensions.result: Node options, file-tool fan-out, state.mjs folders, all fixed

dimensions.name: Gaps, scaling, test value
dimensions.result: Import losses, install, test gaps, all fixed

fixed: Import took boxes in a comment or indented code and deleted them from the roadmap. Fixed in 6cb0e7c.

upgrading: Run `install user` first, then `install project` in each project. A project with a hand-kept checkbox roadmap moves it once with `node .claude/state.mjs list import "_Master Roadmap.md"`, as the use check says.
limits: The import reads boxes under level-two version headings as roadmap steps; any other heading stays a section name. Rows from before 1.36.0 get a short name only when list shorten runs.

tests.flips: declared tests on v1.35.0 and on this branch; the PR run gives the final count
